name: HaloModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Halo's window: HaloProject (compositions, the selected one, unique names), HaloTimeline (each composition's playhead, timecodes, the layers active at a frame, the strip's rows, in and out points at the playhead), HaloLayer (kind, span, color, opacity, CoreRaster blend mode, solid rectangle), FrameRenderer (composites a composition's solids into one preview frame with CoreRaster), HaloStatusText (the inspector header, Composition rows and status-bar timecode text), the New Composition draft and its validated settings, RefusedRename, which keeps a refused composition rename for the alert, and the inspector TEXT section's rules (HaloTextDraft, a field draft kept with its layer; the refusals TEXT owns; the size bar's drag range).
